title: A New Building Efficiency Target Looks Beyond Total Energy Use

sources.name: International Energy Agency (IEA)
sources.title: Making buildings more efficient offers a major opportunity to bring down energy bills and reduce emissions

sources.name: United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)
sources.title: Climate action key to affordable housing, but buildings decarbonisation stalls

paragraphs.en: On November 5, 2026, the International Energy Agency
paragraphs.zh: 2026年11月5日，國際能源總署

paragraphs.en: published new analysis on making buildings more efficient.
paragraphs.zh: 發布了提升建築能源效率的新分析。

paragraphs.en: Prepared at the request of Turkey and Australia,
paragraphs.zh: 這項分析應土耳其及澳洲的要求製作，

paragraphs.en: the report examines a proposed global target:
paragraphs.zh: 報告檢視了一項全球目標提案：

paragraphs.en: improving buildings' energy intensity by at least 25%
paragraphs.zh: 讓建築的能源密集度至少改善25%，
期限為2035年。

paragraphs.en: The agency says existing technologies could achieve this,
paragraphs.zh: 該機構表示，現有技術有能力達成這點，

paragraphs.en: but progress would need to accelerate substantially.
paragraphs.zh: 但進步速度需要大幅加快。

paragraphs.en: The proposal concerns how efficiently buildings use energy.
paragraphs.zh: 這項提案關注的是建築使用能源的效率。

paragraphs.en: Energy intensity compares energy consumption with building size.
paragraphs.zh: 能源密集度是將能源消耗與建築面積相比。

paragraphs.en: Consider a simple illustration: a building uses
paragraphs.zh: 舉一個簡單的假設例子：某棟建築使用

paragraphs.en: 100 units of energy per square metre each year.
paragraphs.zh: 每年每平方公尺100單位的能源。

paragraphs.en: If that falls to 75 units,
paragraphs.zh: 如果降為75單位，

paragraphs.en: its intensity has decreased by 25%.
paragraphs.zh: 能源密集度就下降了25%。

paragraphs.en: These invented numbers explain the measure;
paragraphs.zh: 這些假設數字只是用來解釋指標；

paragraphs.en: they are not a forecast.
paragraphs.zh: 並不是預測。

paragraphs.en: A lower figure means less energy per unit of area,
paragraphs.zh: 數字較低，代表每單位面積所用的能源較少，

paragraphs.en: which differs from measuring an entire country's total consumption.
paragraphs.zh: 這與衡量整個國家的總消耗量不同。

paragraphs.en: The IEA identifies four main areas for improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 國際能源總署指出四個主要改善領域。

paragraphs.en: These are better building envelopes, greater electrification,
paragraphs.zh: 包括改善建築外殼、提高電氣化程度、

paragraphs.en: more efficient equipment, and wider access to clean cooking.
paragraphs.zh: 提升設備效率，以及擴大潔淨烹飪的取得機會。

paragraphs.en: A building envelope separates indoor and outdoor conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 建築外殼將室內與室外環境分隔。

paragraphs.en: Improving it can reduce the work
paragraphs.zh: 改善外殼，可以減少

paragraphs.en: that heating and cooling equipment must perform.
paragraphs.zh: 供暖與冷房設備必須承擔的工作。

paragraphs.en: Equipment upgrades address another part of the problem:
paragraphs.zh: 設備升級則處理了問題的另一個面向：

paragraphs.en: how efficiently machines deliver the services people need.
paragraphs.zh: 機器如何更有效率地提供人們所需的服務。

paragraphs.en: Australia's government guide, Your Home, explains
paragraphs.zh: 澳洲政府的《Your Home》指南解釋，

paragraphs.en: that insulation slows the flow of heat.
paragraphs.zh: 隔熱材料能減緩熱的流動。

paragraphs.en: It helps keep indoor heat from escaping in winter
paragraphs.zh: 它有助於減少冬季室內熱量流失，

paragraphs.en: and outdoor heat from entering in summer.
paragraphs.zh: 以及夏季室外熱量進入室內。

paragraphs.en: However, the guide also emphasizes climate and design.
paragraphs.zh: 不過，指南也強調氣候與設計的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Insulation works alongside measures such as shading and ventilation.
paragraphs.zh: 隔熱需要與遮陽、通風等措施相互配合。

paragraphs.en: This technical background helps explain why
paragraphs.zh: 這些技術背景有助於說明，為什麼

paragraphs.en: building improvements involve a coordinated system,
paragraphs.zh: 建築改善涉及一套需要協調的系統，

paragraphs.en: rather than one product suitable for every location.
paragraphs.zh: 而不是一種適用於所有地點的產品。

paragraphs.en: An earlier United Nations Environment Programme report
paragraphs.zh: 聯合國環境署先前的一份報告

paragraphs.en: provides context for the new analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 為這項新分析提供了背景。

paragraphs.en: In its May 19, 2026 release, UNEP said
paragraphs.zh: 在2026年5月19日發布的新聞稿中，聯合國環境署表示，

paragraphs.en: global building energy intensity had fallen by 8.5%
paragraphs.zh: 全球建築能源密集度已下降8.5%，

paragraphs.en: since 2015.
paragraphs.zh: 比較起點為2015年。

paragraphs.en: Yet the world's building floor area
paragraphs.zh: 然而，全球建築樓地板面積

paragraphs.en: expanded by 1.7% in 2024.
The figures highlight two simultaneous changes:
paragraphs.zh: 這些數據凸顯了同時發生的兩種變化：

paragraphs.en: buildings can become more efficient
paragraphs.zh: 建築可能變得更有效率，

paragraphs.en: while the total amount of building space grows.
paragraphs.zh: 但建築空間的總量也持續增加。

paragraphs.en: The new IEA analysis calls for policy packages
paragraphs.zh: 國際能源總署的新分析呼籲採用整套政策，

paragraphs.en: that combine stronger standards with faster renovations.
paragraphs.zh: 結合更嚴格的標準與更快速的翻修。

paragraphs.en: It also discusses equipment performance requirements
paragraphs.zh: 它也探討設備性能要求，

paragraphs.en: and support for technologies such as heat pumps.
paragraphs.zh: 以及對熱泵等技術的支持。

paragraphs.en: The appropriate mix varies with national circumstances.
paragraphs.zh: 合適的組合會隨各國情況而異。

paragraphs.en: Meeting the proposed target would require
paragraphs.zh: 要達成這項目標提案，

paragraphs.en: more than doubling current improvement rates.
paragraphs.zh: 改善速度必須提高至目前的兩倍以上。

paragraphs.en: That makes delivery speed important alongside technical capability.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，除了技術能力，落實的速度也很重要。

paragraphs.en: For readers following energy news, the key distinction
paragraphs.zh: 對關注能源新聞的讀者來說，關鍵區別

paragraphs.en: is between a building's efficiency and total demand.
paragraphs.zh: 在於建築效率與總需求並不相同。

paragraphs.en: Lower consumption per square metre is valuable,
paragraphs.zh: 降低每平方公尺的能源消耗很有價值，

paragraphs.en: but growing floor area can offset some savings.
paragraphs.zh: 但樓地板面積增加，可能抵銷部分節能效果。

paragraphs.en: The reports therefore encourage a broader view
paragraphs.zh: 因此，這些報告促使人們從更廣的角度

paragraphs.en: of technology, construction growth, and implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 看待技術、建築規模成長與實際執行。

paragraphs.en: The practical question is how these factors interact
paragraphs.zh: 實際的問題在於，這些因素如何相互作用，

paragraphs.en: when countries plan their future buildings.
paragraphs.zh: 以及各國在規劃未來建築時如何考量它們。

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of the article?

choices.text: To provide detailed instructions for installing insulation.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第4段只提供隔熱與設計的背景概念，沒有列出施工或安裝步驟。

choices.text: To confirm that global building energy consumption has already fallen by 25%.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第1段談2035年的能源密集度目標提案，並非全球總能源消耗已實際下降25%。

choices.text: To explain a proposed efficiency target and why energy per area matters.
choices.explanation: 正確。第1段介紹新目標，第2段說明能源密集度，第7段總結它與總需求的差異。

choices.text: To rank countries by their current building efficiency.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章沒有國別效率排名，而是討論全球目標、技術與政策。

quiz.explanation: 本題考主旨。全文以11月5日的新分析為新聞起點，解釋目標衡量的是能源密集度，以及技術、建築面積成長和執行速度如何影響結果；不是施工教學或已達標的公告。

evidence.quote: the report examines a proposed global target: improving buildings' energy intensity by at least 25% by 2035.
For readers following energy news, the key distinction is between a building's efficiency and total demand.

quiz.question: What can be inferred if energy use per square metre falls while total floor area grows?

choices.text: The intensity improvement alone does not guarantee a fall in total energy use.
choices.explanation: 正確。第2段把單位面積指標與國家總消耗區分，第7段指出面積成長可能抵銷部分節能，因此不能只憑密集度下降保證總量下降。

choices.text: Every building must have become larger and less efficient.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。總樓地板面積成長不代表每一棟建築都變大，也不能否定題目已說明的單位面積能源消耗下降。

choices.text: The same percentage decline must occur in national total consumption.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第2段明確區分單位面積能源密集度與國家總量，兩者不能直接套用相同百分比。

choices.text: Floor area no longer matters once an efficiency target is proposed.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第5及7段持續強調樓地板面積成長的影響，並未因提出目標而忽略它。

quiz.explanation: 本題考合理推論。總能源消耗同時受單位面積用能和總面積影響。當兩者朝相反方向變化時，必須知道變化幅度才能判斷總量，不能只看效率指標。

evidence.quote: A lower figure means less energy per unit of area, which differs from measuring an entire country's total consumption.
Lower consumption per square metre is valuable, but growing floor area can offset some savings.

quiz.question: Which conclusion best summarizes the approach described in the article?

choices.text: One insulation product can deliver the same result in every climate.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第4段說隔熱須與氣候、設計、遮陽和通風配合，並非單一產品適用於所有地點。

choices.text: Countries should wait for entirely new technologies before acting.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第1段說現有技術就有達成目標的能力，問題包含加快進展，不是等待尚不存在的技術。

choices.text: Equipment upgrades remove the need for building renovations or standards.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第3段列出多種改善面向，第6段也主張標準與翻修並行，並未用設備升級取代其他工作。

choices.text: Existing technologies need coordinated policies, suitable design, and faster implementation.
choices.explanation: 正確。第1段提現有技術與加速，第4段提協調設計，第6段則提出政策組合與改善速度。

quiz.explanation: 本題考整體總結。文章描述的是將多種現有技術和政策結合，配合不同情況並加快落實。只依靠單一產品、等待全新技術或忽略翻修標準，都不足以概括全文。

evidence.quote: The agency says existing technologies could achieve this, but progress would need to accelerate substantially.
Insulation works alongside measures such as shading and ventilation.
The new IEA analysis calls for policy packages that combine stronger standards with faster renovations.
